create.name: Jessica Prestia
create.bio:
Jessica Prestia, who teaches as Jessbeinspired, is a Reiki master, intuitive reader and meditation teacher now based in Venice, Los Angeles, after several years working in South Florida. She trained as a meditation teacher with davidji and also works with crystals, sound and astrology. She founded The Academy For The Inspired, through which she has taught Reiki levels and certification classes, and she has hosted local Reiki circles, community gatherings and larger collaborative healing events.

Her current work blends astrology with Reiki in what she calls Astro-Reiki. Clients book online readings of different lengths, from a short card reading to a long natal chart session, and each one combines intuitive guidance, chakra balancing and energy work, sometimes with messages from spirit guides or animal guides. Her monthly membership, The Inspired Collective, gathers members for live circles, open questions, restorative sessions with breathwork and sound, and group oracle readings, and she sends a weekly newsletter of astrology themes and reflective prompts. On Insight Timer she shares short guided practices on the Reiki principles, moon cycles, the third eye and connecting with guides. Her style is warm, colourful and personal.

courses.title: The Inspired Collective
courses.description: A monthly online membership with a live session every Friday: an Astro-Reiki circle, an open Q&A, a restorative session with breathwork and sound, and a group oracle reading. Members also get a Monday email, replays and a library of practices.

courses.title: Signature Astro-Reiki Intuitive Energy Reading
courses.description: A private hour online that mixes astrology-informed insight, chakra balancing, Reiki and intuitive messages. It suits people at a crossroads or wanting to feel clearer and more grounded.

courses.title: Astro-Reiki Natal Chart Reading
courses.description: A two-hour online session devoted to your birth chart, read through an intuitive lens and paired with Reiki. She spends a further two hours preparing the chart beforehand.

courses.title: Astro-Reiki Card Reading
courses.description: A short 30-minute video reading with oracle cards, a little astrology and a brief burst of Reiki. Meant as a quick check-in when you want a fresh perspective.

free_resources.title: Jessica Prestia on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations under her Jessbeinspired name, including practices on the five Reiki principles, new and full moons, the third eye and meeting spirit guides. Free to listen to.

free_resources.title: Soul Signals Newsletter
free_resources.description: A free weekly email with oracle messages, the astrology of the week, journal prompts and simple practices. Sign up on her site.

Owner may prefer to list her as Jessbeinspired.

Location conflict: Insight Timer and her Linktree (a free Venice Beach series in Oct 2026) put her in Venice, Los Angeles; her older WordPress site jessbeinspired.com still says Delray Beach, FL. Plan uses Los Angeles; in-person evidence is thin (beach series, private events), sessions are online.
Email is a Gmail address published on her Linktree and old site contact page.

Older site's services page says Reiki 'enhances your body's natural ability to heal itself'; mild, not condition-sold, so not a skip.
